results.title: US spy chief visits Russia for meetings, media reports
results.description: WASHINGTON, Aug 25 (Reuters) - U.S. CIA Director John Ratcliffe traveled to Moscow on Tuesday for meetings with Russian officials, U.S. media outlets reported, citing unnamed sources.

results.title: Donald Trump's statement in full after country legend Dolly Parton dies at 80
results.description: Country music legend Dolly Parton died at the age of 80. President Donald Trump has ordered flags to be flown at half-staff across the United States for one week in her honor.

results.title: A cultural renaissance is reshaping national identity in wartime Ukraine
results.description: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine is fueling a defiant cultural outpouring that is redefining and strengthening Ukrainian national identity in ways that challenge centuries of Kremlin imperialism, writes Davis Richardson.
